weaknesses.title: CUTALL missing column yields empty fields that FREQ as ghost :N
weaknesses.detail: CUTALL col past end keeps line count with empty strings; FREQ produces ':2' style rows that look like real rank entries. Agents ranking wrong column pollute top-N silently.

weaknesses.title: No multi-line ARG — loadlines needs ||| glue hack
weaknesses.detail: Cannot pass real access log lines with spaces via WORDS; agents invent separators. Soft READ file is alternative but loadlines is ARG-bound.

weaknesses.title: FREQ encoding path:count still ambiguous for URLs with ://
weaknesses.detail: FREQ of http://heavy → http://heavy:3. SORTFREQ sorted correctly (likely last-colon peel) but storm/agent AFTER first ':' peels '//heavy:3' and NUM fails — dual peel semantics across forms.

weaknesses.title: CUTALL/FREQ/SORTFREQ/TAKE all non-mutate
weaknesses.detail: Pipeline needs LET after every step; easy to WRITE stale raw instead of rank.
weaknesses.repro: FREQ paths; SORTFREQ paths still unsorted without LET

weaknesses.title: Pin uses GREP substring — false friends
weaknesses.detail: pin /api matches /api/users and /api/orders and /apiv2. No whole-field or word-boundary GREP.

weaknesses.title: No SQUEEZE empty after CUTALL in pipeline
weaknesses.detail: Agents must remember SQUEEZE BLANK after bad peels; rank does not auto-drop empty path tokens.
weaknesses.repro: CUTALL OOR then FREQ counts empties

weaknesses.title: Inconsistent colon peel: SORTFREQ vs AFTER
weaknesses.detail: SORTFREQ ranks URL paths correctly; manual storm peel with AFTER first colon fails. Agents need documented last-colon form (RAFTER) or FREQ with safer sep default for paths.
weaknesses.repro: SORTFREQ ok on http://x:N; AFTER first breaks

workarounds: Validate CUTALL_HIT / reject empty path tokens with SQUEEZE BLANK before FREQ
Use loadlines ||| or READ file for multi-token access lines
Prefer SORTFREQ over manual AFTER peel for rank order
For storm on URL paths use SPLIT+TAIL count or FREQ custom sep '='
language_gaps: CUTALL option to drop missing-column lines
Multi-line ARG or ARG-file ingest form
FREQ sep default that cannot appear in keys
WRITE force trailing NL; PRINT_JSON newlines
issues_faced: WORDS cannot ingest 'METHOD path status' — invented ||| loadlines
CUTALL OOR silent empty fields → ghost FREQ rows (high agent footgun)
URL paths work with SORTFREQ but break AFTER-based storm peel — dual semantics
